exposure: quarterly supportive supervision, mentoring and teleconsultation
3-month training program in anaesthesia skills for emergency obstetric surgeries for associate clinicians
outcome: uptake of the educational program for anaesthesia
cohort: Pregnant women in seven health centres in rural Tanzania.
finding: A 3-month training program for associate clinicians in anaesthesia, along with supportive supervision, increased the CD rate and the proportion of operations performed under spinal anaesthesia.
